_comment: NEGATIVE FIXTURE N08 — unsafe net (place holds >1 token). A fork t_a produces into p1 and p2; both branches t_b and t_c deposit into the SAME place p3 without a synchronising join transition. After firing t_a, t_b, t_c the marking holds 2 tokens in p3 => not 1-bounded. The paper's translation targets the safe-and-sound class, so an unsafe net is a manufacturing defect: analyze_petri_net reports is_safe=false (unsafe_marking holds p3=2). Minimal counterexample: replace t_b and t_c with a single synchronising join transition consuming p1 AND p2 and producing one token in p3.
